info.title: 3Common API
info.description: Public REST API for the 3Common event management platform.

get.description: Lists every segment that contains a given member (optionally filtered by target type).

Workspace-scoped paginated list. Supports targetType / folderId
/ status / search and the same JSON filter expression contacts
list accepts. Pass `folderId='unfiled'` to scope to segments
that have no folder set.

post.description:
Creates a segment. `name` is unique within
(targetType). Duplicates → 409 with `error.details.conflictingId`.
Empty filter rejected with 422.

get.description: Fetch a segment by id. 404 if absent or owned by another workspace.

patch.description:
Patches a segment. `targetType` is immutable; passing it is
a type-level error. Renames may collide → 409.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the segment. Membership rows are preserved (hard-cleanup is admin-only).

post.description: Freezes the current membership and stops filter-driven recompute. Equivalent to HubSpot's schedule-conversion endpoint, applied synchronously.

get.description: Paginated members of a segment. Defaults sort `joinedAt` desc.

post.description: Adds a member to a static segment. No-op if already present (returns `inserted: false`).

delete.description: Removes a member from a static segment.
